fixes: §0 TL;DR bullet 7: fixed self-contradiction between FSQ's stated {-L,...,L} (2L+1 levels) value set and the L^d codebook-size formula — now states each dim gets L_i fixed levels (matching §9.2), and clarified that 'no learnable codebook parameter' does not mean 'no STE' (round is still non-differentiable, needs a one-line STE)

§5.3 Free bits callout + Q12: corrected overclaim that the max(KL,λ) clamp 'guarantees λ bits per dim' — the clamp only zeroes the gradient below threshold (stop penalizing further collapse), it does not actively push raw KL back up to λ; true KL can still sit near 0

§7.5 LPIPS + Q18: corrected overclaim that LPIPS is 'standard for diffusion training' — it is standard for the VQ-GAN/SD-family VAE tokenizer (first-stage autoencoder) and most image GANs, but standard diffusion denoisers train with plain L2 regression on noise/velocity/flow and do not use LPIPS
§8.2: DALL·E 2 is unCLIP (CLIP embedding prior + diffusion decoder), not a VQ-GAN-leaning model as previously stated; corrected to note it does not use VQ-GAN discrete tokens at all

§9.3 + Q9: softened the overclaim that reconstruction pressure guarantees 100% grid coverage in FSQ — near-100% usage is an empirical regularity from the paper, not a structural/mathematical guarantee

§9.2 formula + §9.5 code: fixed the FSQ bounding implementation — real FSQ (Mentzer et al. 2024) adds the even-level parity shift on tanh's *input* side (with an atanh-derived shift) plus an eps safety margin, not a bare tanh(z)*half - offset with no eps; the tutorial's own code was internally inconsistent (docstring promised an eps parameter that the constructor never declared). Added `eps` param, precomputed `atanh_shift = atanh(offset/half)`, and changed the bound to `tanh(z + atanh_shift) * half - offset`

§11.2 ecosystem diagram: DALL·E 1 moved off the VQ-GAN row onto a new dVAE row (it uses a discrete VAE + Gumbel-softmax, not VQ-GAN's codebook + LPIPS + adversarial construction) — matches the tutorial's own correct §8.1 text
§11.2 ecosystem diagram: OpenMagViT2 moved from the FSQ row to the LFQ row — it is an LFQ-based (binary lookup-free) tokenizer, matching the tutorial's own §9.7 table, which already had this right

§9.6 LFQ entropy regularization prose + code: fixed the actual mechanism — real LFQ/MAGVIT-v2-style entropy regularization minimizes per-sample (per-token) entropy (confident per-bit decisions) while maximizing batch-aggregate (marginal) entropy (even code usage across the batch), plus a commitment term; the tutorial's code previously just maximized every sample's own entropy (pushing sigmoid(z) toward 0.5 — literally the opposite of a confident quantization decision) with no batch-usage term at all
